messages:
Sam (AE): Quick thread to align on Northerly Bank POC auth scope. They're asking for delegated domain verification, SCIM scoping, SAML attribute mapping, and how billing works if multiple subsidiaries share one contract.
Ravi (Northerly Sec): Hi all 5 we want each subsidiary to control its own domain verification and admins, but the corporate team wants a single invoice. Also need SCIM to only create accounts for users in synced groups, not all directory users.
Priya (SE): We can do delegated domain verification. Two options: 1) DNS TXT token per-namespace (subsidiary creates TXT under their domain), 2) Email verification to an admin alias (no org admin required). DNS is preferred for automation. Example TXT: `_rdw-verify=84d2b7n`. Use `dig TXT _rdw-verify.subsidiary.com`.
Jon (Security): For SAML, request for SP metadata and a recommended attribute list. Also confirm whether we store the full SAML assertion in logs (we don't store raw assertions by default; we log event metadata). I'll provide a short security FAQ.
Priya (SE): SAML recommended attributes we request: NameID (email), givenName, familyName, groups (multi-valued). Example SP entityID: `https://auth.redwood.ai/sp/subsidiary` and ACS: `https://auth.redwood.ai/saml/acs`. We can accept signed assertions and enforce idp certificate pinning.
Ravi (Northerly Sec): Can the groups claim be filtered server-side? They only want 3 groups to create accounts: netops, app-admins, auditors.
Priya (SE): Yes 5 filter in two places: best practice is to configure the IdP provisioning rule to only send those groups. Additionally, we can configure a provisioning filter on our side to ignore other groups. For the POC we'll set a whitelist.
Sam (AE): What about create-on-provision vs link-only? Legal prefers link-only for some subsidiaries.
Priya (SE): We support both. Link-only: SCIM will only link users that already exist, returning errors for unknown users. Create-on-provision: we POST users into the tenant. We'll mark this in the onboarding checklist per-sub.
Jon (Security): SCIM security notes: we support token rotation and IP allowlist. SCIM rate limits for Hosted: 100 req/min; Dedicated/Private can raise limits on request. I'll confirm the SLA for SCIM availability.
Ravi (Northerly Sec): Good. Also can you scope admin roles so a subsidiary admin cannot see other subsidiaries' prompts or model usage?
Priya (SE): Yes 5 namespace RBAC. Admins are scoped to a tenant namespace tied to domain verification. Usage & audit logs are partitioned. Cross-tenant super-admins are controlled separately (corporate role).
billing-bot: New invoice policy: single contract with multiple billing centers supported. Discounts on reserved capacity are applied at the contract level; we can credit specific billing centers if requested.
Sam (AE): Procurement question: if they buy dedicated reserved capacity for the whole corp, can we show per-subsidiary metering and apply seat discounts?
billing-bot: Yes. We can report token consumption per namespace and apply tiered seat discounts. Finance will need estimated steady-state tokens/day and peak concurrent requests.
Ravi (Northerly Sec): We will provide traffic estimates. One technical blocker from compliance: they want proof that domain ownership didn't require handing over DNS admin to Redwood team.
Priya (SE): We never request DNS admin rights. DNS flow is owner adds TXT record; we validate via public DNS only. For delegated verification we issue short-lived tokens that you paste as TXT. We can also provide an ownership JWT signed by us after verification for your records.
Jon (Security): I'll attach a one-page note on KMS usage, whether we use customer-managed KMS in Private, and where audit logs live. For Hosted, logs may be replicated to eu-west but retention is an add-on.
Sam (AE): Action items: Priya 5 send SAML metadata + sample SCIM whitelist config; Jon 5 security note + retention options; billing-bot/Finance 5 template for token/day and cost model; Ravi 5 share traffic + confirm link-only vs create-on-provision per-sub. POC kickoff scheduled Thu 09:30 UTC.
Ravi (Northerly Sec): Thanks all. One last ask 5 can you provide a small test harness (curl sample) to exercise SCIM create/link flows so our IdP team can validate?
Priya (SE): Sure. Sample SCIM create (link-only mode):
```bash
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_TOKEN>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \ 
  -d '{"userName":"jane.doe@northerly.com","emails":[{"value":"jane.doe@northerly.com"}],"externalId":"12345"}'
```
Priya (SE): We'll also give a small playbook for DNS TXT rotation and verifying with `dig`.
Sam (AE): Perfect 5 I'll compile and send to Ravi after we have Jon's security FAQ. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
